steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Externalities: divergence private/social costs/benefits; Negative: MSC>MPC (pollution); Positive: MSB>MPB (education)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Pigouvian tax = MEC at optimum; Subsidy = MEB; Tradable permits: cap-and-trade; Regulation: standards/bans

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Public goods: non-excludable (can't stop use), non-rival (one's use doesn't reduce other's) -> free rider -> underprovision

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Info asymmetry: adverse selection (pre-contract, hidden info), moral hazard (post-contract, hidden action); Solutions: signalling, screening, regulation

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: A factory pollutes a river. MPC = 20+Q, MEC = 5, MPB = 100-Q. Find market output, social optimum, and tax --- Solution: Market: MPC=MPB -> 20+Q=100-Q -> Q=40. Social: MSC=MSB -> 20+Q+5=100-Q -> 2Q=75 -> Q=37.5. Tax = MEC = 5 per unit. At Q=37.5, P=100-37.5=62.5. Tax revenue = 5x37.5=187.5
